newsitem.title: USA: PSE to list Roadway Express options.
newsitem.headline: PSE to list Roadway Express options.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange said Monday it would begin trading options on shares of Roadway Express Inc on January 30.

The exchange said the options would open with strike prices of 20, 22-1/2 and 25 with expirations in February, March, June and September. Position and exercise limits have been set at 4,500 contracts.
The stock was down 5/16 at 21-3/16 Monday afternoon.
The PSE said Roadway options have been allocated to pit representatives Glenn Gsell and Ross Goodheart. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
